name: michalstaniecko/terminarz
description: Online appointment booking plugin for WordPress with optional WooCommerce payments.

scripts.test:integration: npx wp-env run --config=.wp-env.tests.json cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/terminarz vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs unit and integration test suites (integration needs `npm run env:start:tests`).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Runs unit tests (no WordPress, no Docker).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Runs integration tests inside the wp-env tests environment.
